name: app-nutrition-app-wireframe-to-visual-tilted-screens-on-lilac
title: Grey wireframe screens for a meal-planning app with two tilted photo-rich phones on lilac
whatItIs: A lilac board with a grid of pale grey wireframe screens (weekly progress, meal plan, recipe detail with macros) and three oversized tilted phones showing the finished recipe screen with a wrap photo, pastel macro rings and orange kcal.
whatItMeans: Clear about process; tilted finished screens burst out of the grey wireframes.
techniques: Show grey wireframes as the base grid.
Break out with oversized tilted high-fidelity phones.
Use pastel ring charts for macros.
Keep the background a single lilac.

vocabulary.definition: A ring chart of protein, carbs or fat.
A phone oversized and tilted out of a grid.
A layout of grey structural screens.
